head: a685e07
scopeNote: Wave-25 D four milestones. Milestone 1 is the safety tool and full resource list; later milestones add A→C same-manifest consumption, readiness/F package and ordinary/reopen/support. E remains independent; zero real vendor/model/native turns.

resourceSet.unknownPolicy: mixed [valid,null] keeps null as record_missing_in_mixed_set; unknown retains private state; group signal only for spawn-before-record after fresh launcher proof
resourceSet.signalPolicy: each TERM and each KILL re-reads target identity; identity change/missing/unreadable stops that signal; no stale proof reuse

d1.summary: Fixed baseline and listed every live role/field. Old prerecord/childstart/sibling/null results retained; new child config/captured argv/entry/operation and mixed-null gaps are explicitly closed by controls, not by a single local PASS.

d2.summary: TERM wait then KILL no longer reuses targets/proof: every signal re-reads only its target (launcher or one child) and records fresh evidence. Identity change, missing target or failed read stops that signal and keeps UNKNOWN.

d3.summary: Child identity binds actual config, captured full argv, entry, role and startup operation; captured tokens must equal current tokens; sibling roots and wrong entries refuse. Mixed [valid,null] preserves the unknown member.

d4.summary: 14 pure controls pass (own positive, child start/config/entry, sibling, wrong operation, PID reuse, missing, cleanup failure, repeated finally, stop timeout, mixed null, empty). Two bounded live faults: before-record UNKNOWN retained with fresh group signal; after-seed CLEAN. Normal same-store/nonempty/real still pass.

d5.summary: A producer + separate-PID reader verified complete original subject on the kept same-Store root; a tampered manifest was rejected before body read. C package driver verified-flow on the same exact Store. LIMIT: C did not consume the A manifest as an input object; that direct binding remains NOT_TESTED.

d6.summary: From the same original Store create/verify workflow-snapshot/1 and /2; each format separately materialized, independently bundled and restored to its own new root. Each restored root was then consumed by the C unique driver and returned verified-flow with bound requested/live digest. Each DB sha equals its snapshot manifest; original Work/question/answer IDs preserved. Bad manifest is rejected by the A reader.

notDone: C directly consuming A manifest object
limitations: Old 3b package is a positive control only; it cannot certify wave25 readiness/F bytes
